summary_en: Kobe Bussan authorized the acquisition of up to 16 million shares (7.21% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 4.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from September 30, 2026 to April 30, 2027. The repurchase aims to enhance shareholder returns and mitigate short-term market impact from a concurrent convertible bond issuance.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On September 29, 2026, Kobe Bussan's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury shares based on the company's articles of incorporation under Article 459, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Companies Act. The company may acquire up to 16 million shares, representing 7.21% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) as of July 31, 2026, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 4.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including off-market transactions, between September 30, 2026 and April 30, 2027.

The company stated two objectives for the repurchase program. First, it aims to enhance shareholder returns. Second, the acquisition is intended to mitigate the short-term impact on the company's stock supply and demand that would result from the concurrent issuance of a convertible bond with acquisition rights maturing in 2033, denominated in euro-yen. Proceeds from the convertible bond offering will be used to fund this repurchase. The company separately announced that it would execute a block acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (an off-market fixed-price transaction) on September 30, 2026 for 4.0 billion yen in total acquisition value.
